freeze: phone inputs v1 for Spark phone expansion (read-only snapshot)
schema: Each row: id, group_id, contract_id, contract_version, contract_availability, family, reflex_type, utterance, context, candidates, option_ids, fallback_id, typed_arguments, expected_disposition, deterministic_basis, provenance{source,template_family,generation_origin,note}, label_status=needs_teacher, split
grouping: group_id groups paraphrases of one scenario instance; splits assign whole groups; dev/calfit groups disjoint from train and from frozen data_dev/calfit/report groups (phone_validate PASS)
ingest_rule: Spark labels ingested only after artifact + grouping checks (ids, types, candidates, option map, full fixed-k, no imputation). Source groups stay separate from evaluation.
spark_expansion_dir: /tmp/pocket-glimmer-training-scale/spark-phone-v1 (owned by Spark worker; this worker only reads final verified artifacts)
